summary.zh: 把设计稿、组件与变量接入对话
summary.en: Bring designs, components, and variables into the conversation

description.zh:
读取 Figma 文件中的设计上下文，包括组件、样式与变量。
适合在实现界面前获取准确的设计信息。
description.en:
Read design context from Figma files, including components, styles, and variables.
Useful for getting accurate design details before building UI.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Figma 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Figma in the browser and authorize on first connect.
